components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action for search, submission, and saving.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-ink); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; font: 800 16px/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-dark); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Strong Admin Button
components.description: High-emphasis save or report action in admin flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-strong { background: var(--color-brand-dark); color: var(--color-white); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; font: 800 16px/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: filter 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-strong:hover { filter: brightness(.9); } .ds-btn-strong:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-dark); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action beside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-white); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 700 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-brand-dark); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-dark); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled text entry for guest requests and admin forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--color-ink); font: 700 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-white); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-brand); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(255 115 0 / 16%); }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Shared header brand and compact guest/admin links.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; background: var(--color-cream); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); padding: 16px 24px; font: 700 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-white); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; } .ds-nav-admin { border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-white); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 8px 16px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-admin:hover { border-color: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-brand-dark); } .ds-nav-admin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-dark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-white); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); } .ds-card-image { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: var(--color-cream); color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px; } .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0; color: var(--color-brand-dark); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-card-copy { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card-bottom { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); padding-top: 16px; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-card-bottom .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Success Chip
components.description: Compact status badge for a confirmed reservation.
components.css: .ds-chip-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-forest); color: var(--color-white); padding: 4px 10px; font: 700 12px/1.5 var(--font-sans); }

narrative.overview:
Travelando feels like a friendly, practical starting point for finding an escape. Warm cream and orange create an inviting catalog; direct headings, clear controls, and sturdy action buttons keep the path to a cabin easy to follow. The system uses a native sans-serif voice rather than a decorative display face, so the interface stays familiar across guest and admin tasks.

The guest catalog is welcoming and image-led where cabin photography exists. Administrative screens reuse the same surfaces and controls, with denser tables and lists that prioritize scanability. Pine green marks successful or confirmed states. The visual mood is warm and direct, not a polished luxury-resort aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream surfaces, orange actions, and graphite text.
Compact labels and bold, tightly tracked headings.
Rounded, thin-bordered cards with restrained depth.
Responsive, utility-led layouts shared by guest and admin pages.

rules.name: The Orange-Action Rule
rules.body: Trail Orange signals discovery and focus; Burnt Trail carries filled actions and strong text for contrast.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Keep cards flat at rest; reserve shadow for hover feedback or the report surface that needs a clearer boundary.

dos: Do use Trail Orange for brand and discovery cues, and Burnt Trail for filled primary actions.
Do use Pine Green and Pine Mist for successful or confirmed states.
Do preserve the shared card, form, and button language across guest and admin screens.
Do let responsive grids add columns at established breakpoints rather than shrinking content too far.
donts: Don't turn the cabin catalog into a polished luxury-resort aesthetic.
Don't add decorative colors or a separate display font without a deliberate system change.
Don't use shadow as the default way to separate cards; borders and tonal surfaces do that work.
